q1_issues.issue: The well-wish is asserted as fact: (Member sk_birthday_1 happy) at strength 1.0 claims the birthday IS happy, which the text never states.

The dedication "To Laura" and the sign-off "Love, Pete" are unrepresented — laura and pete are bare Name atoms with no relation to the birthday or to each other, and the birthday is never tied to Laura.

q2_gaps: verbless optative / formulaic well-wish ("Happy 40th birthday") — no construct records a wish without asserting its content
card/letter framing: a dedication line ("To X") and a sign-off ("Love, X") — no addressee/sender relation for a message exists
notes: (Ordinal sk_birthday_1 40 birthday) uses the birthday as both entity and scale — the closest licensed fit for "40th", but self-referential.
